item.title: With Winter Olympics over, LA is officially on the clock for 2028 Summer Games
item.description: In fair Verona, L.A., unofficially, takes the torch.

item.title: U.S.-Canada ‘grudge match’ ends up being mostly about the hockey
item.description: It was a game destined to be played under the shadow of politics, but in the end, fans mostly put aside the growing animosity between the Trump administration and Canada’s government to cheer on top-tier ice hockey at the Winter Olympics.

item.title: Team USA honors the late Johnny Gaudreau after winning Olympic gold in Milan
item.description: The dramatic Olympic gold medal win by the United States men’s hockey team on Sunday, which snapped a 46-year drought for the Americans, will be remembered forever. But amid the celebrations and flowing tears of joy in Milan after Jack Hughes’ overtime goal against the Canadians, Team USA’s players had one of their fallen teammates at the front of mind.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck and Jack Hughes join Jim Craig and Mike Eruzione as US Olympic hockey champions
item.description: Go ahead and put the names Jack Hughes and Connor Hellebuyck right in the same revered place that Mike Eruzione and Jim Craig have occupied since their “ Miracle On Ice ” triumph in 1980.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins at Atlanta to give Michael Jordan second straight NASCAR Cup victory
item.description: Whether on or off the racetrack, all Michael Jordan does is win in NASCAR.

item.title: Golf roundup: Bridgeman hangs on at Riviera for first PGA Tour title. Thitikul wins LPGA event at home in Thailand
item.description: Jacob Bridgeman heard cheers all day long for everyone but himself Sunday at Riviera until the final ovation. He made a nervy par putt on the 18th hole for a 1-over 72 and a most narrow victory in the Genesis Invitational for his first PGA Tour title.

item.title: Podziemski’s late scoring leads Warriors to a 128-117 win over the Nuggets
item.description: Brandin Podziemski scored 12 of his 18 points in the final five minutes of the fourth quarter and the Golden State Warriors beat the Denver Nuggets 128-117 on Sunday.

item.title: Asking Eric: Adult daughter’s job struggles keep mother from finding happiness

item.title: Slugging 1B Nick Kurtz looks to build on AL Rookie of the Year award in 2nd season with Athletics
item.description: Aside from towering over most of his Athletics teammates at 6-foot-5, Nick Kurtz blends in at his locker in the middle of the clubhouse — and that’s just the way he prefers it.
